observations: Photo 0 shows a black 3-seater style couch/sofa with tufted/boxy cushions and gold-colored legs.
Photo 1 shows another view of a black 3-seater style couch/sofa (same design, gold legs).
Photo 2 shows a black 2-seater style couch/sofa with tufted/boxy cushions and gold-colored legs.

identity.kind: 2 seater and 3 seater tufted sofa set (black fabric, gold legs)

claims.evidence: Photos show one larger (3-seater style) sofa (photo 0/1) and one smaller (2-seater style) sofa (photo 2).
No price shown in the photos; 'giveaway' is a subjective seller statement.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in these angles (tears, worn fabric, sagging cushions, broken frame).
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of: (1) seat cushion bottoms/underside, (2) armrest corners, (3) backrest seams, and (4) a photo showing the sofa from the side to check sagging.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used and potentially needing repair/with wear (worst case: not fully firm/possible fabric wear).

risks.risk: Upholstery staining/odor (common with used sofas) not captured by the photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a quick video sniff/close-up of fabric and a wipe test on a hidden area; also ask if it was cleaned recently.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly stained/with odor risk.

risks.risk: Legs/structure stability (gold legs could be loose or uneven).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the sofa being gently pushed from the front and sides to show it doesn’t wobble; include a photo of each leg base.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if legs may need tightening/replacement.

risks.risk: Missing parts or mismatched set (photos could be from different listings or not the exact pair being sold together).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing both the 2-seater and 3-seater together in one frame, plus a receipt/ID or the same listing tag visible on both.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if the set may be incomplete/mismatched (worst case: treat as single item value).

proof_requests: Send one photo showing both sofas (2-seater and 3-seater) together in the same frame.
Send close-ups of fabric condition: seams, arm corners, and any stains/tears.
Send a side-angle photo to check cushion sagging and frame firmness.
Send a short video showing the sofa being pushed lightly (no wobble) and showing all legs.
response.reason: The photos confirm a black tufted 2-seater and 3-seater sofa style, but key pricing drivers for Lagos pickups—true condition (sagging/tears/stains), stability, and whether it’s the exact complete set—aren’t provable from these images alone.
